zeroReleaseProject.question: does the JSON API answer 404 or 2xx for a registered project with zero releases
zeroReleaseProject.answer: 404, read from warehouse's own JSON view at f9ce83647318089c485c3d66378d559f0e7cdeed (warehouse/legacy/api/json.py, latest_release_factory): the project route resolves through the latest release, and a project with no release, or with every release or the project itself in quarantine, raises NoResultFound and returns HTTPNotFound. Such a name is therefore a critical unknown-package although it is registered; it is also not installable by pip, so the finding does not block an install that would have worked. No live example was located in this run, so this is a source reading, not an observed answer
zeroReleaseProject.related: the same view answers 301 for a name that is not in normalised form, which is why dep-guard always asks for the normalised name and never follows a redirect; yanked releases are still served (open point 3)
